'''Jeremy Baker''' finished 2nd in the [[Young Jedi]] World Championship at [[DecipherCon 2002]], winning $200.<ref name="pc-nov02">[http://www.swccgpc.com/Archives/november02archives.htm November Updates], Josh Radke, swccgpc.com (3 November 2002). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20030423221953/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Archives/november02archives.htm Internet Archive]</ref> At [[DecipherCon 1999]] he finished 3rd in Young Jedi Qualifier #1 and 7th on Day 2 of the Young Jedi World Championship.<ref name="lal-fri">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/lalumiere/friday.html DecipherCon '99 — Day 2 Wrap-up], Francis K. Lalumiere, Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001120001100/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/lalumiere/friday.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="dc99yj05_1">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ05_1.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: YJ World Championships Day 2], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010105010700/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ05_1.html Internet Archive]</ref>
